inner_servo_evaluation.basis: Numerical evaluation of the assumed continuous Runtime PD/torque-speed law at each rigid physics step; not measured digital-servo rate.
inner_servo_evaluation.unchanged: Gains, caps, physical inertia/armature, target envelopes,20ms policy period and command delay,10ms feedback delay and nominal sensor rates.
inner_servo_evaluation.sensor_resolution: Accumulated nominal sensor clocks are quantized to physics steps. Actual capture/receive timestamps must be retained; nominal rates alone do not imply identical event times.

numerical_scope: Matched slow-reference comparison removed unloaded knee/ankle1ms chatter but did not complete a step. This resolves an observed numerical mode, not general convergence or physical servo calibration.
